The Castle At Taunton - Unique Family Owned Hotel
Skip to content
The Castle Hotel
The Castle Hotel is a unique family-owned hotel set in a historic building in the heart of Taunton in Somerset. A simple ethos lies at the heart of everything we do to offer the warmest of welcomes, give the utmost personal attention and exemplary service to each and every one of our guests. The Castle Hotel is a one-off, not a link in a chain.

Explore more
Working at The Castle
We’re growing our team and recruiting across multiple hotel departments.
Opportunities available in reception, waitstaff, bar staff, and supervisory roles.
Email us for more information
A warm welcome awaits
The Castle’s reputation for fine food and wine, comfort, and attentive service has been built by three generations of the Chapman Family, with a passion for promoting the highest standards in every aspect of the hotel. Taunton lies at the heart of the region, making The Castle the ideal base from which to explore the history, magic and wonder of the West Country.

pages.text:
Stay - The Castle At Taunton
Skip to content
Stay Overnight
Whether you’re in Taunton for school speech day, a day at the cricket or for business, you’ll find each of our 44 bedrooms offers its own personality and comfort away from home. Book direct with us at The Castle for the best available rates.
Book to stay
View our rooms here
Our rooms
Unlike so many of today’s hotels, The Castle’s rooms are individually decorated, each varying in size and design. We are the perfect base from which to explore beautiful Somerset. Book direct for the best available rates including Dinner, Bed & Breakfast packages with a meal to remember in our award-winning restaurant, Brazz.
Check availability
Castle rooms
Newly renovated, spacious and indulgent with king sized beds, tiled walk-in showers and bathrooms stocked with Bramley products, these rooms have everything you need. With a sofa bed and generous velvet armchairs, they are perfect for family getaways, long stays or couples looking for a romantic break. These rooms can also be booked with the Penthouse for a completely private and exclusive stay.
Check availability
Virtual tour
Garden rooms
Double aspect gothic windows with views to the Norman garden, our garden rooms are traditionally decorated in the English country style with sprawling super king beds, generous wardrobe space, some with separate dressing and sitting room areas and plenty of room for a z-bed for young children.
Check availability
Virtual tour
Deluxe double/twin
Super king beds, some of which can be twinned, our deluxe double rooms are roomy and comfortable. For families with older children, some of these rooms are adjoined by a spacious hallway or interconnecting door and some can even accommodate additional z beds.
Check availability
Virtual tour
Cosy double
Our recently refurbished cosy doubles may well surprise you. They are generous in size for a short stay and offer all that you would expect to find in a four star hotel. Cosy doubles boast smart TVs, USB charger sockets and a desk area so ideal for the working traveller.
Check availability
Virtual tour
Double
Our charming double rooms all have king sized beds and are in the oldest part of the hotel with beautiful stone mullion windows. All rooms have armchairs and a writing or breakfast table.
Check availability
Virtual tour
Deluxe single
Stay in style in our elegant and modern deluxe single rooms. With double beds and plenty of space they’re perfect for the solo guest.
Check availability
Virtual tour
Car Parking
Car parking is available at the hotel for residents & guests alike.
Please take a ticket on entry & retain until departure.
Parking is charged at £1.95 per hour or £10.95 per night per car for overnight guests.
Payment can be made at reception via credit or debit card.
Electric Vehicle Charging
We have Four Electric 22kw chargers that require a type 2 cable s at The Castle Hotel. A payment of 75p per kwh will be required to use our EV Chargers.
For any queries, contact EV charger support at: 01774630335

pages.text:
The Drawing Room - The Castle At Taunton
Skip to content
The Drawing Room
We have created this elegant and peaceful new space for your enjoyment. Be you resident in the hotel or a local visitor, please relax in comfort and allow us to serve you from our menu of refreshments throughout the day and evening. Should the room attendant be absent when you arrive, please make yourself known to the hotel’s reception desk and we shall call a team member to attend.
Book to eat
Virtual tour
About The Drawing Room
About The Drawing Room
If you’re looking for a quiet and civilised corner for a morning tea, coffee, pastries, snacks, The Drawing Room is Taunton’s best kept secret. Our guests come here to read a newspaper or meet a friend. Our menu offers fresh, generously filled sandwiches, smoked salmon, and much, much more. Our snug offers a comfortable, cosy corner and can be privately booked.
Traditional afternoon tea
Enjoy a delicate but indulgent selection of dainty finger sandwiches, freshly baked scones with lashings of Somerset clotted cream and jam, delicious homemade cakes and pastries – all made by our Patisserie and accompanied by a pot of tea or coffee of your choice from our wide loose-leaf selection.
£27.50 per person
Book A Table
Sample Menu
Champagne afternoon tea
Why not add a touch of sparkle with a glass of Champagne. Also includes a selection of delicate finger sandwiches, warm scones with clotted cream and jam and a variety of homemade cakes and pastries made by our Patisserie.
£41 per person.
Book A Table
Exclusive use
The Drawing Room is the perfect venue for drinks and canapé receptions for up to 26 people. The adjoining snug offers a cosy nook and can be privately booked for a meeting or more intimate gatherings.

pages.title: About - The Castle At Taunton
pages.text:
About - The Castle At Taunton
Skip to content
Our Story
The Castle at Taunton is a unique and historic family-owned hotel . For the Chapman family, good hospitality is a very personal engagement between host and guest. This makes The Castle Hotel a one-off, not a link in a chain. It is our livelihood, our passion.
Read more
Our hotel today
The Chapman family has run this wisteria-cloaked Grade 2 listed landmark in the centre of Taunton for over seventy years, through good times and some more challenging periods. Throughout this time, a simple ethos has underpinned us – to give the warmest of welcomes, the utmost personal attention and exemplary service to each and every one of our guests.
A family affair
Peter and Etty Chapman arrived in Taunton in 1950 to find the hotel a sad post-war wreck. They painstakingly restored the historic building, later adding a third floor. Their son, Kit, returned to the family business in 1976, with a particular drive to build the hotel’s reputation for a great kitchen, while his wife Louise set about transforming the interiors. In 1998 Brazz was born, a concept which has evolved into the much talked about award-winning restaurant of today.
Now Nicholas and Annabel Chapman lead the business as it s third generation. With the support of the team, they are working to revive the hotel after the unexpected challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic. Among many other things, the enforced closure of the hotel caused a disappointing delay to a planned refurbishment of some bedrooms and the larger public spaces but, overseen by Annabel, work has now re-started. January 2022 saw our iconic Garden & Wisteria Rooms transformed, whilst our main kitchen benefitted from a major investment. A bespoke English manufactured Induction Suite was installed, assisting our goal towards more sustainable working practices.
Unlike so many of today’s hotels, The Castle’s rooms are individually designed and decorated.
Our people
People are what make the difference in any business, particularly one where the warmth of welcome and the personal attention to each guest matters so very much. We have a large team, each of whom play a key role in their different ways.
Our core team includes:
Nicholas Chapman – Chairman & CEO. After a career in digital marketing and new media in the UK and abroad, Nick succeeded his father as head of the family firm in 2016.
David Plant – Hotel Manager. David joined The Castle in 2020 as the Operations Manager. With a huge passion for hospitality, his beliefs match those that The Castle has built its reputation on. David was promoted to Hotel Manager in March 2025.
Anna Bajera – Office Manager. Anna joined The Castle in 2005 working here way up the ranks in the F&B operations team.  In 2023 Anna joined the Finance and HR Team. She was promoted to Office Manager in 2025 and now runs the HR, Finance and Admin function at the hotel.
Stuart Carter – Facilities & Building Manager. Since 2009, Stuart has overseen the complex upkeep of this historic building and knows every inch of the hotel. He has run numerous modernisation projects and the work never stops.
Carol Byrne – Head Housekeeper. One of our longest serving members of staff at over 20 years, Carol won the “unsung hero award” from Bristol, Bath & Somerset Tourism Award in 2021.
Food heritage
The heart of The Castle lies in its buzzing, award-winning kitchen. Our mission has always been to seek out the finest local ingredients and to transform them into dishes which highlight the best produce in the West Country. The meadows and orchards, uplands and pastures, rivers and seas of England’s West Country provide our kitchen with the best raw materials for our menus.
We have long been famous for spotting and recruiting gifted young chefs, encouraging them to develop and master their craft. Great chefs who began their rise to success at The Castle include Chris Oakes (who won us our first Michelin Star in 1984), Gary Rhodes, Phil Vickery, Richard Guest and Liam Finnegan.
Today, Jacques Ballinger commands the stoves in The Castle s kitchen. Following in the footsteps of an illustrious list of previous Head Chefs, Jacques is now making his mark. From a hearty breakfast or midmorning coffee and freshly-baked pastries, to working lunches or an indulgent afternoon tea , right through to a gastronomic dinner with paired wines, Jacques and his team serve up the very best.
Our history
As the resident custodian of this great local landmark, the family’s seventy years of ownership are a mere blip in The Castle’s long and turbulent history. Although The Castle s origins are obscure, it is generally believed that The Castle in it s present form began to take shape under Bishop William Giffard (1107-29), when it served as the centre of the Norman Bishop s estate. The building we see today, has been lovingly renovated and maintained by the Chapman family for the last seventy years.
It is believed that, towards the end of the 12th century, Henry De Blois built the Keep of The Castle the strongest portion of The Castle s fortification, and the place of the last resort in case of siege or attack. This structure would prove key to this Castle s history, as it had a largely defensive function throughout it s existence and underwent numerous sieges, including during the civil war of 1644. However, The Castle s role as a defensive structure came to an end in 1662, when orders were issued to destroy. Following it s demolition, the Keep was used as a garden until it was taken over by the Somerset Archaeological and Natural History Society in 1873 who has ensure it s preservation to this day.
Parts of the stone structure, notably Castle Bow, reach back to the 13th century. In 1685, the Duke of Monmouth, illegitimate son of Charles II, arrived in Taunton to proclaim himself King on 20th June. One historian noted that “Monmouth’s officers were heard roistering at the Castle Inn” before his defeat at the Battle of Sedgemoor on 6th July. N

wikipedia.title: Castle Hotel, Taunton
wikipedia.extract: The Castle Hotel at Taunton is a hotel with one restaurant, Brazz, and a number of events spaces, located in the centre of Taunton, Somerset, England. The business is located in a Grade II listed 18th-century reconstruction of the former 12th-century Norman fortress, Taunton Castle.
